params.name: id
params.description: The invoice ID used to identify the invoice to be downloaded.

items.docs:
Get a link to download the invoice PDF.
 **Token scopes**: `accounting:read`

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: The invoice ID used to identify the invoice to be retireved.

params.name: payment_id
params.description: Unique identifier for the payment to retrieve the breakdown.

items.docs:
Get a full breakdown of a payment made to Deel. Breakdown will include individual invoices and Deel fee as line items.
 **Token scopes**: `accounting:read`

params.name: limit
params.description: Return a page of results with given number of records; NOTE technically ALL query parameters are strings or array of strings

params.name: offset
params.description: Return a page of results after given index of row; NOTE technically ALL query parameters are strings or array of strings'

items.docs:
Retrieve a list of invoices related to Deel fees.
 **Token scopes**: `accounting:read`

params.name: issued_from_date
params.description: Filter invoices issued on or after the specified date.

params.name: issued_to_date
params.description: Filter invoices issued before the specified date.

params.name: status
params.description: If status query has value of all, all invoices will be returned. Otherwise only paid invoices will be fetched.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to retrieve per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Index of the first record to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Return next page of results after the given cursor.

params.name: include
params.description: Will include invoices from COR workers in the response.

items.docs:
Retrieve a list of paid invoices for your workforce.
 **Token scopes**: `accounting:read`

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filters results to include payments created on or after this date (in ISO 8601 format).

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filters results to include payments created before this date (in ISO 8601 format).

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor for pagination. Use the value returned in the 'next_cursor' field to get the next page of results.

params.name: currencies
params.description: Filters payments by their currency codes. Can be a single currency code or an array of codes.

params.name: entities
params.description: Filters payments by legal entity type (e.g., 'individual' or 'company'). Can be a single entity type or an array.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Filters payments by their status (e.g., 'paid' or 'processing'). Can be a single status type or an array.

items.docs:
Returns a cursor-paginated list of payments made to Deel, including worker details, payment status, and payment methods. Use the `next_cursor` value from the response to retrieve subsequent pages.
 **Token scopes**: `accounting:read`
